title: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM HUMAN FEEDBACK WITH HIGH-CONFIDENCE SAFETY CONSTRAINTS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to prompts specifically categorized as 'Social Bias' from the Safe RLHF dataset by using GPT-4 as a judge to compare win/tie/lose rates against baseline models, and utilizing a harmlessness evaluation rubric that explicitly checks for discrimination, stereotypes, and prejudice.
